keyPoints: Samikaran me char (variable) wale kathan ko barabar ke chihn se likhte hain — ek sankhya ka doguna 10 se 2x = 10 banta hai.
Samikaran ka hal wo maan hai jo char ki jagah rakhne par dono paksh barabar kar de — 2x = 10 me x = 5 hal hai.
Pakshantar (transposition) me sankhya paksh badalne par chihn badalta hai: x + 7 = 12 se x = 12 - 7 = 5.
Guna-bhaag wale samikaran me ulta karo: 3x = 21 se x = 21 ÷ 3 = 7; x/4 = 5 se x = 5 x 4 = 20.
Do-padi samikaran pehle jod-ghata hatakar, phir guna-bhaag hatakar hal karo: 2x + 6 = 18 se 2x = 12, x = 6.
Vyavaharik sawalon me pehle agyat ko x maano, phir kathan ko samikaran me badlo aur hal karo.
Aam galti: pakshantar me chihn na badalna — x - 4 = 9 me x = 9 - 4 = 5 galat hai, sahi x = 9 + 4 = 13 hai.
subject: Maths
title: Saral Samikaran
